workflow_recipes.name: asset-governance-codex-home
done_criteria: declared source assets and generated live assets are consistent
governance report contains the changed manifest relationships
dry-run and real apply complete without protected path writes
final health checks pass or residual risk is explicitly recorded
failure_modes: manifest references unknown profile, skill, agent or workflow
live drift is outside allowed policy
generated config differs from manifest source
secret or private endpoint appears in a manifest
trigger_examples: 按建议优化 ~/codex 资产治理并同步到 ~/.codex
新增或修改 manifest 后完成 build doctor apply check
negative_examples: 只解释某个普通业务函数如何工作
只做一次不涉及 Codex Home 的网页文案修改

workflow_recipes.name: implementation-strong-goal
done_criteria: implementation matches the stated scope
tests or smoke checks cover the success criteria
no unrelated user changes are reverted
completion claim is backed by command evidence
failure_modes: goal lacks executable validation
scope change was not reflected in the target template
tests pass only because the wrong target was exercised
completion statement exceeds the evidence
trigger_examples: 按强目标模板实现这个功能并跑验证
修复这个 bug，范围限定在当前模块并给出测试证据
negative_examples: 只总结今天读到的官方文档
只登记一个 MCP server，不改业务代码

workflow_recipes.name: external-research-review-note
done_criteria: sources are current for the stated date sensitivity
claims are attributed to primary or official sources when available
recommendations separate evidence from inference
reusable conclusions are routed to archive or memory candidate review
failure_modes: unofficial source is treated as authoritative
current information is answered from stale memory
long quoted passages exceed citation limits
temporary research notes are promoted as permanent rules without review
trigger_examples: 查 OpenAI 官方文档并总结可吸收的 Codex 优化点
核验最新官方 API 文档后给出迁移建议
negative_examples: 不联网，只根据本仓代码修复测试
只运行本地 check.sh 并汇报结果

workflow_recipes.name: official-docs-to-governance
done_criteria: OpenAI Docs MCP is used first when available, with official-domain fallback recorded when unavailable
source_urls and review metadata are recorded in official_docs_freshness_gates before long-term promotion
guidance changes are represented as workflow, eval, prompt experiment or trace contracts before expanding AGENTS text
build, governance doctor, apply dry-run and runtime-control final decision support the completion claim
failure_modes: official docs MCP is disabled and fallback source is not restricted to OpenAI domains
a dynamic or one-off source is promoted into stable guidance without expiry
AGENTS.md grows with long procedural text that should live in a skill or recipe
prompt or policy behavior changes without before/after samples and rollback
trigger_examples: 按 OpenAI 官方 Developers 内容全面优化 ~/codex 并落地
把 OpenAI 官方 Codex workflows 和 eval 建议转成本仓 governance manifest
negative_examples: 只查一个 OpenAI API 参数怎么用
只根据本地测试失败修一个普通代码 bug

workflow_recipes.name: local-runtime-boundary-governance
done_criteria: permission profiles keep danger-full-access and open network defaults forbidden
exec rules use exact prefix examples and non-examples instead of broad command allowlists
hook contracts state unsupported coverage and remain disabled until separately reviewed
automations remain report-only or manually reviewed and do not create real schedulers
governance tests, doctor and strict-config doctor support the completion claim
failure_modes: default config mixes beta permission profiles with legacy sandbox_mode without review
a broad allow rule grants bash, python, git, curl or npx directly
a hook contract claims complete enforcement while official hook coverage is incomplete
a local automation silently starts a recurring background job
Cloud, GitHub, Slack or Linear integration is introduced despite local-only scope
trigger_examples: 按官方 permissions/rules/hooks 建本地 Codex 运行边界
把 Codex app automations 建成本地 report-only 审计，不接外部集成
negative_examples: 只查一个 OpenAI API 参数
集成 GitHub Action 或 Slack bot
为单个业务项目新增 CI 配置

workflow_recipes.name: wechat-account-research-archive
context_inputs: canonical WeChat account names and aliases
done_criteria: plan, evidence, catalog, coverage and run summary agree
only direct-read or separately reviewed official-mirror records enter the catalog
negative access, account and date states remain visible
article bodies, browser state and signed redirect URLs are not persisted
all generated catalog entries remain review-required
coverage limitations and search-index latency are disclosed
failure_modes: a CAPTCHA or login gate is treated as a retry signal
proxy, identity, UA or cookie rotation is used to continue collection
search snippets or third-party mirrors are treated as account proof
article bodies or temporary signed URLs are written to the evidence pack
heuristic quality scores automatically promote or delete records
collection silently modifies Hermes data, ADK assets, memory or AGENTS
trigger_examples: 全面收集腾讯技术工程近半年 Agent 和 MCP 相关文章
使用搜狗和 Hermes 索引批量归档两个微信公众号
negative_examples: 打开这一个微信链接并总结
只根据本地 catalog 评估已归档文章
绕过公众号验证码继续抓取

workflow_recipes.name: embedded-remote-hil-session
context_inputs: user-authorized endpoint source without persistent field IP
frozen candidate, staged and installed artifact identities
watchdog, auto-standby, supervisor and other state mutators
HIL stage, retry budget, timeout layers and stop conditions
done_criteria: host route, transport, shell and app/diag are independently classified with evidence
unreachable state opens a circuit breaker and prevents device writes or unbounded retries
candidate, staged and installed identities plus backup anchor are reviewable before mutation
HIL expands only from single smoke to short cycle, long stress and soak after each gate passes
final state restores the healthy normal profile, closes temporary diagnostics and records final identity
evidence bundle is sanitized, hashed and does not persist endpoint, credentials, raw logs, core or binaries
failure_modes: ping failure short-circuits ADB probing
adb connect exit code is accepted despite failure text or non-device state
transport, shell and app/diag timeouts are collapsed into one health result
device loss triggers repeated deployment attempts or is attributed to the current patch without evidence
build success is treated as staged, installed, image or OTA identity
watchdog or standby competes with HIL and the result is reported as single-cause
long stress starts before short-cycle gate or final normal-state restoration is omitted
trigger_examples: 设备恢复后先做 ADB 只读 preflight，再核对候选制品并执行 HIL 板测
ADB No route to host，熔断部署并转串口或电源恢复
远程部署候选到目标板，按 5 次、1000 次和 soak 分阶段复测
negative_examples: 只分析粘贴的 ADB 日志文本，不连接设备
只构建本地二进制，不连接设备也不部署
分析 PCR02 core 和 SigmaStar 工具链匹配

workflow_recipes.name: knowledge-hub-maintenance
context_inputs: knowledge source path or item id
intended action: capture, classify, migrate, promote or retire
done_criteria: item classification is explicit
registry impact is listed
no authority boundary is violated
checks are specified before any write
automation remains report-only unless a separate approved execution task allows writes
failure_modes: project-specific content is promoted into team standards
personal note is included in a team active index
memory is used as the only source of truth
raw logs or secrets are copied into text knowledge
trigger_examples: 检查 Knowledge Hub 并给出提升候选
把项目 docs 外置迁移到 Knowledge Hub 的计划落地
知识库自动化只读巡检
negative_examples: 只修一个普通业务代码 bug
直接把候选写入 ~/.codex/memories

workflow_recipes.name: governed-activity-reporting
context_inputs: daily, weekly or custom inclusive period
explicit personal, project or portfolio scope, or configured default_scope
Knowledge Hub activity facts v2 or permission to generate it report-only
explicit subject_id for personal scope and optional project_id
requested brief, normal or full detail
done_criteria: period and timezone are explicit
facts and work items use schema v2 only
bare report prompts use configured default_scope or return needs-input
source coverage and privacy flags are checked before rendering
work status and verification status remain distinct
projects are grouped into bounded workstreams rather than chronological sessions
personal ownership is never inferred from Git, paths, memory or conversation context
raw sessions, logs, credentials and unrestricted local paths are not persisted
report generation does not write memory, promote facts, commit, publish or send
review_artifacts: Chinese personal, project or portfolio activity report
failure_modes: a commit, dirty worktree, plan or memory cue is presented as completed work
a Git author, path, memory cue or chat identity is used as personal ownership
an old facts, work-item or receipt schema is read or converted
missing scope or subject silently falls back to another report view
raw session text or authentication state is copied into the report
weekly period silently uses UTC or an incorrect week boundary
a lower-authority memory cue overrides Hub current facts
missing repositories or receipts are hidden instead of reported as coverage gaps
trigger_examples: 结合 Knowledge Hub 和 Codex 记录生成本周周报
生成我的个人日报
给我所有项目的日报，按项目和工作流归并
用自动报告 facts JSON 生成一份管理层周报
negative_examples: 只总结当前会话并生成 session receipt
只汇总当前仓库今天的 Git 提交
直接读取并复制 raw Codex session
从 Git author 猜测个人周报归属
